stem: A high-risk plant-health finding is confined to one propagation zone and has not been confirmed elsewhere. Which response best preserves biosecurity while the finding is evaluated?
choices: Maintain the facility's applicable isolation, sanitation, and clean-to-dirty movement controls; document scope; and escalate according to the authorized procedure.
Move suspect plants through other rooms to compare symptoms under different conditions.
Share tools between the affected and unaffected zones to test whether the problem spreads.
End isolation immediately because the cause is not yet confirmed.
rationale: Uncertain cause does not remove spread risk. Applicable quarantine, sanitation, and movement controls should be maintained while scope and cause are evaluated.
